differences.en: This page runs the mock communication agent, planner, skills, and evidence gate inside the browser. It does not call a chat-completions model.
differences.zh: 这个页面在浏览器里运行模拟模式的沟通代理、规划代理、技能和证据门，不会调用对话模型。

differences.en: Catalog, policy, and shipment tools run in-process on the synthetic snapshots. There is no MCP child process and no network call to a store or carrier.
differences.zh: 商品、政策和物流工具在页面进程内读取合成快照。没有 MCP 子进程，也不会访问商店或承运商。

differences.en: Session memory uses in-memory SQLite and an in-memory cache. MySQL and Redis are not used. Entering a scenario clears them.
differences.zh: 会话记忆使用内存中的 SQLite 和内存缓存。不使用 MySQL 或 Redis。进入一个场景会清空它们。

differences.en: The separate local Python server can use a configured model endpoint. This page never contacts that server and has no place to enter an API key.
differences.zh: 另外的本地 Python 服务可以连接已配置的模型端点。这个页面不会访问那个服务，也没有填写密钥的入口。

differences.en: The page uses the built-in default settings. It ignores SHOPASSIST environment variables and the local settings file. The local server still applies those.
differences.zh: 页面使用内置默认设置，忽略 SHOPASSIST 环境变量和本地设置文件。本地服务仍会读取它们。

differences.en: The page sends the sentence shown on each shortcut. Chinese questions such as 这个商品多少钱 are parsed directly. Catalog category ids such as drinkware stay in English.
differences.zh: 快捷按钮发送的就是按钮上的那句话。这个商品多少钱这类中文问题会直接解析。目录里的品类 id 如 drinkware 仍是英文。

differences.en: Nothing here places an order or takes payment. Shipment answers describe the synthetic snapshot only.
differences.zh: 这里不能下单，也不能付款。物流回答只描述合成快照。

differences.en: Knowledge search on this page uses the prebuilt hashing lexical baseline shipped with the static files. It is not a semantic embedding and it is not a live vector database or MCP process.
differences.zh: 本页的知识检索使用随静态文件发布的哈希词面索引。它不是语义向量，也不是在线向量库或 MCP 进程。

differences.en: The page records a simulated communication-agent and planner lifecycle around the real tool calls, then reveals the validated reply in short steps. Those calls do not leave the browser, and the pauses are not model latency.
differences.zh: 页面在真实工具调用前后记录模拟的沟通代理和规划代理过程，再把已核对的回答分段显示。这些调用不出浏览器，停顿也不是模型延迟。

en.text: How much is the Blue stoneware mug 350 ml?

zh.text: Blue stoneware mug 350 ml 多少钱？

purpose.en: Ask the price of the canvas court shoes opened from the product page.
purpose.zh: 询问从商品页带进来的这双帆布鞋的价格。

limits.en: Uses the consulted product in the session. The snapshot name stays English.
limits.zh: 用会话里正在看的商品。快照里的商品名仍是英文。

welcome.en: Hello. You opened the canvas court shoes from the product page. Ask for the price when you want it. I will not send a question for you.
welcome.zh: 你好。你从商品页打开的是这双帆布鞋。想问价格时再发。我不会替你发出问题。

context_note.en: Open item: Canvas court shoes. Price and stock come from the snapshot quote.
context_note.zh: 当前商品：Canvas court shoes。价格和库存来自快照报价。

en: How much is the Canvas court shoes?

purpose.en: Ask whether these canvas court shoes are in stock.
purpose.zh: 询问这双帆布鞋是否有货。

limits.en: Stock comes from the quote, not from the page address.
limits.zh: 库存来自报价，不来自网址。

welcome.en: This conversation checks whether the canvas court shoes are in stock. Ask when you are ready.
welcome.zh: 这次对话是核对这双帆布鞋有没有货。准备好再问。

context_note.en: Stock is read from the quote. The page address is not the stock count.
context_note.zh: 库存来自报价。网址里的内容不是库存。

en: What is the stock count for this item?

purpose.en: Search the drinkware category under a budget. These are the in-stock matches under 20.
purpose.zh: 在预算内检索 drinkware。这些是 20 以内且有货的匹配。

limits.en: The category id drinkware is English in the snapshot.
limits.zh: 品类 id drinkware 在快照里是英文。

welcome.en: This conversation searches drinkware under 20. The pictures are the catalog items that search can return. Nothing is searched until you ask.
welcome.zh: 这次对话是检索 20 以内的 drinkware。图片是这次检索可能返回的目录商品。你发问之前不会检索。

context_note.en: Category id drinkware stays English. Budget 20 is the sample.
context_note.zh: 品类 id drinkware 仍是英文。示例预算是 20。

purpose.en: Compare the matte ceramic mug and the blue stoneware mug.
purpose.zh: 对比哑光陶瓷杯和蓝色炻器杯。

samples.en: compare Matte ceramic mug 350 ml and Blue stoneware mug 350 ml
samples.zh: 对比 Matte ceramic mug 350 ml 和 Blue stoneware mug 350 ml

limits.en: Both names must be the snapshot names.
limits.zh: 两个名字都必须是快照里的英文名。

welcome.en: This conversation compares the matte ceramic mug and the blue stoneware mug. Send the comparison when you want both quotes.
welcome.zh: 这次对话对比哑光陶瓷杯和蓝色炻器杯。想看两边的报价时再发送对比。

context_note.en: Both names must stay the snapshot names.
context_note.zh: 两个名字都必须用快照里的英文名。

en: compare Matte ceramic mug 350 ml and Blue stoneware mug 350 ml
zh: 对比 Matte ceramic mug 350 ml 和 Blue stoneware mug 350 ml

purpose.en: Read the current return window while viewing the canvas court shoes.
purpose.zh: 在查看这双帆布鞋时读取现行退货时限。

limits.en: This is the shared fixture note, not a promise from a carrier or a per-item rule.
limits.zh: 这是共享的夹具说明，不是承运商承诺，也不是单件商品规则。

welcome.en: This conversation reads the shared return note while the canvas court shoes are the open item. It is not a promise from a carrier.
welcome.zh: 这次对话在看这双帆布鞋时读取共享的退货说明。这不是承运商的承诺。

context_note.en: The return note is the fixture policy, not a rule stored on the shoe.
context_note.zh: 退货说明是夹具政策，不是写在这双鞋上的规则。

purpose.en: Look up synthetic tracking id TRK-OK from this shop chat.
purpose.zh: 在这个店铺对话里查询合成单号 TRK-OK。

limits.en: TRK-OK is synthetic. It is not a live carrier lookup.
limits.zh: TRK-OK 是合成单号，不是实时承运商查询。

welcome.en: This conversation looks up synthetic tracking id TRK-OK. It is not a live carrier lookup, and nothing is sent until you ask.
welcome.zh: 这次对话查询合成单号 TRK-OK。这不是实时承运商查询，你发问之前不会查询。

context_note.en: Tracking id for this scenario: TRK-OK.

purpose.en: Ask for tracking id TRK-NO-SUCH, which is absent from the snapshot.
purpose.zh: 查询快照里没有的单号 TRK-NO-SUCH。

limits.en: An empty snapshot is not a carrier saying the shipment does not exist.
limits.zh: 快照为空不等于承运商否认这票货。

welcome.en: This conversation looks up tracking id TRK-NO-SUCH, which is absent from the snapshot. An empty snapshot is not a carrier saying the shipment does not exist.
welcome.zh: 这次对话查询快照里没有的单号 TRK-NO-SUCH。快照为空不等于承运商否认这票货。

context_note.en: Tracking id for this scenario: TRK-NO-SUCH.

purpose.en: Retrieve the fictional membership note from the hashing index.
purpose.zh: 用哈希索引检索虚构的会员说明。

limits.en: The score is a hashing cosine, not a semantic relevance score. The prefix is required.
limits.zh: 分数是哈希余弦，不是语义相关度。需要这个前缀。

welcome.en: This conversation retrieves the fictional membership note from the hashing index. The score is not semantic relevance, and the document body is not followed.
welcome.zh: 这次对话用哈希索引检索虚构的会员说明。分数不是语义相关度，也不会照着文档正文说。

context_note.en: Prefix the question with kb policy: so the hashing index is queried.
context_note.zh: 问题需要以 kb policy: 开头，才会查询哈希索引。

en.title: Demo Flagship Store
en.banner: Deterministic demo · synthetic catalog · no checkout
en.welcome: Hello. You opened this chat from the product page. I can check this item's price and stock, and the return note, using the synthetic catalog.
en.no_checkout: This demo cannot place an order.
en.unknown_product: That product id is not in the snapshot. No price or stock is shown.
en.unsupported: I can answer price, stock, and the return window for the item you are viewing. Other questions need one of the supported sentences.
en.price_line: This item is {price} {currency}, with {stock} in stock.
en.returns_line: The current return window is {days} days for unused items.
en.knowledge_line: Hashing index facts: {facts}. The document body was not followed.
en.no_match: Nothing in the snapshot matches that request.
en.several: These items matched. Prices and stock are from the snapshot.
en.trace_empty: Send a question to see the route, skills, tools, and evidence gate for this conversation.

limitations.logistics_not_in_snapshot: That tracking id is not in the snapshot. This is not a carrier saying the shipment does not exist.
limitations.logistics_unavailable: No usable tracking status came back.

shipment.empty: The snapshot has no record for that id.

en.sim_ca_handoff: Simulated CA handed this turn to the planner.
en.stream_label: Simulated streaming. Pauses are for reading, not model latency.

zh.title: 演示旗舰店
zh.banner: 确定性演示 · 合成目录 · 不能下单
zh.welcome: 你好。你是从商品页进来的。我可以用合成目录核对这件商品的价格、库存和退货说明。
zh.boot_sqlite: 正在加载本地目录存储。
zh.unknown_product: 快照里没有这个商品编号，所以不显示价格或库存。
zh.unsupported: 我可以回答你正在看的商品的价格、库存和退货时限。其他问题需要用支持的句子。
zh.returns_line: 现行退货时限是 {days} 天，适用于未使用的商品。
zh.knowledge_line: 哈希索引事实：{facts}。没有照着文档正文说。
zh.no_match: 快照里没有符合这个请求的结果。
zh.several: 这些商品符合条件。价格和库存来自快照。

limitations.no_match: 没有符合已确认条件的结果。
limitations.retrieval_miss: 没有查到可引用的事实。
